name: Immutable construction
text: All numerical code, witness bytes and exact source pins must remain bound to one manifest.

name: Payload and restoration

name: Complete physical price

name: Separate lift and precision claims

name: Complete prime coverage

name: Strict directed moment gap

name: Finite ordinary closure

name: Inherited theorem boundary

name: Evidence honesty

name: Documentation provenance
